verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API client and testing tool, not an API gateway or traffic-management platform, so declaratively managing API infrastructure and syncing it from CI is outside its product category. Its CLI manages and tests request collections, which is not gateway or infrastructure config. Git sync of collections exists only as an open feature request (issue #870), not a shipped capability, so nothing in the evidence flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can manage API infrastructure as declarative config and sync it from CI (GitOps/APIOps)
